summary: Window title setting is implemented, but tests and mypy were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code. Changes: SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType in rich/segment.py, with a Tuple[ControlType, str] member added to ControlCode; the format entry and Control.title classmethod in rich/control.py; Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor in rich/console.py; a legacy-dispatch branch calling term.set_title in rich/_windows_renderer.py; an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200 in CHANGELOG.md; and three tests (test_control_title, test_set_window_title, test_control_set_window_title). Nothing was committed. Choices: the Console test skips on sys.platform == "win32", matching the file's existing convention.
